constitutional_basis: Directive section 12: the central proposition is NOT 'a pressure sensor works' (trivial) — it is that SELF-REFERENCING provides a meaningful improvement in pressure measurement stability/drift/error under relevant conditions vs a BASELINE sensor. The benchmark is built explicitly around baseline vs self-referencing. Constitution Art. XLVII (baseline supremacy; identical instrument across arms).
central_proposition: A self-referencing piezoresistive architecture (active pressure-exposed element + dummy pressure-shielded element sharing the thermal environment, bridge output V_out = (R_active(T,P) - R_dummy(T))/(4R)*V_ex) reduces drift and thermal error materially below a single-ended baseline sensor under catheter-integrated CSF conditions.

language_guard.basis: Directive section 12: do not use 'drift-free'; do not use 'self-calibrating' unless the architecture and evidence support it. The recorded architecture is a differential bridge referencing a dummy element — it compensates COMMON-MODE thermal drift only; it is neither free of drift (non-common-mode drift is uncompensated — the P-25 failure evidence) nor capable of self-calibration (no calibration actuation exists; the dossier's own mitigation for residual drift is PERIODIC RECALIBRATION, which is the opposite of automatic self-calibration).
language_guard.grep_verified: No buyer-facing package surface currently uses either term (verified across the frozen corpus for this package; this record pins the guard)

arms.baseline: Single-ended piezoresistive pressure sensor of the same die/process family (same sensing element WITHOUT the dummy/reference element), same packaging, same electronics chain, same instrument — the architecture's absence is the ONLY difference (Constitution Art. XLVII).
arms.treatment: Self-referencing architecture: active + dummy element bridge per the shipped design (diaphragm 0.07 mm class after the KEEP mutation; reference die included in the shipped CAD).

the_only_measured_self_referencing_resul.package: P-25 (RETIRED — the pressure sensor's direct predecessor, killed at R370J)
the_only_measured_self_referencing_resul.result: 67.8 % drift cancellation BUT 3.45 mmHg error > 2.0 mmHg threshold — FAILED the acceptance threshold; biofouling dominates NON-COMMON-MODE drift
the_only_measured_self_referencing_resul.lesson_codified: KA-014: candidates relying on self-referencing WITHOUT a non-common-mode drift repair mechanism are blocked (the codified lesson blocks exactly this architecture class unless the non-common-mode channel is addressed)

recorded_evidence_basis.the_drift_target: 1-10 mmHg/month (typical, external-precedent literature) -> < 0.5 mmHg/month (drift_compensation_target) — MODEL_DERIVED target, status 'MODELLED — no hardware validation of drift performance' (R370Q dossier)
recorded_evidence_basis.ka014_implication: P-27-R1's recorded mitigations (periodic recalibration, spare capacity) do NOT obviously satisfy KA-014's non-common-mode drift repair requirement — this benchmark's endpoints are designed to measure exactly that unresolved channel. This is the package's largest scientific risk, made explicit.

measurement_matrix.initial_accuracy: Static pressure accuracy over the ICP range (0-40 mmHg class) at reference conditions, both arms, same reference instrument
measurement_matrix.temperature_dependence: Thermal sweep (body-relevant range incl. fever class excursions, e.g. 33-41 C): zero offset and sensitivity drift vs temperature, both arms — the common-mode channel the architecture claims to cancel
measurement_matrix.drift: Long-duration zero/sensitivity drift at fixed conditions (target horizon per the MODEL_DERIVED < 0.5 mmHg/month figure; interim acceleration methods recorded as acceleration-class, never silently equated to real-time aging)
measurement_matrix.hysteresis: Pressure up-down cycles: hysteresis loop area, both arms (the dossier's WP-01 already names sensitivity/linearity/hysteresis)
measurement_matrix.cycling: Pressure/thermal cycling endurance: drift evolution ACROSS cycles (a field the current dossier lacks — added here per directive section 12)
measurement_matrix.aging: Chronic aging study with periodic calibration (the dossier's recorded verification item; here measured as the DIFFERENCE between arms, not just absolute drift)
measurement_matrix.reference_stability: The dummy element's own stability (the reference can drift too — the bridge is only as stable as the reference; measured directly)
measurement_matrix.packaging_effects: Hermeticity per MIL-STD-883 leak < 1e-8 atm*cc/s (recorded WP-03) + packaging-induced stress on both elements (the R370Q failure-mode table's packaging entries)
measurement_matrix.calibration_retention: Time-between-calibration performance: residual error growth after calibration, both arms — the operational meaning of the drift improvement
measurement_matrix.biofouling_channel: The P-25-recorded dominant non-common-mode drift driver: a fouling-exposure protocol arm (accelerated protein adsorption class exposure of the active element vs the shielded dummy — designed to measure whether the architecture's differential signal survives asymmetric fouling; the exact channel that killed P-25)

primary_endpoint: Drift (zero + sensitivity) of the self-referencing arm vs the baseline arm over the pre-registered duration, expressed against the MODEL_DERIVED < 0.5 mmHg/month target — with the improvement ratio (baseline drift / treatment drift) as the headline number. NOTE the P-25 precedent: 67.8 % cancellation FAILED against a 2.0 mmHg error threshold; the acceptance threshold here must be pre-registered with provenance (Art. XXVII), not borrowed from the cancelled P-25 numbers.
secondary_endpoints: thermal zero/sensitivity drift ratio between arms
decision_rule: The architecture EARNS its central proposition only if the treatment arm's drift/error improvement over the SAME-instrument baseline is material on the primary endpoint AND the non-common-mode channels (biofouling, reference drift) do not erase the advantage. If asymmetric fouling dominates (P-25's failure class), the self-referencing premise for THIS application is falsified — repair (non-common-mode compensation mechanism) or cemetery, per the KA-014 lesson.
honest_basis_note: Every planned verification item in the shipped dossier is currently NOT_TESTED; this specification is the first assembly of the baseline-vs-treatment comparison the proposition actually requires. No numbers above are measurements; they are the pre-registration of what must be measured.
